run_pipeline_flux_inpaint: run the FluxInpaintPipeline to generate inpainted images from a source image and mask using a text prompt
encode_flux_inpaint_prompt: encode text prompts into T5 and CLIP embeddings with the FluxInpaintPipeline encode_prompt method
prepare_flux_inpaint_latents: prepare latent variables and mask latents for Flux inpainting with noise scheduling and VAE encoding
calculate_flux_shift: calculate the shift parameter for the FlowMatchEulerDiscreteScheduler based on image sequence length
retrieve_flux_timesteps: retrieve scheduler timesteps from num_inference_steps, custom timesteps, or custom sigmas for Flux inpainting
